homepage.body:
Skip to content

MuleSoft

with Agent Fabric

Control what every agent does, where it reaches and what it spends, no matter who built it.

Watch demo Test drive for free

From APIs to agents, see how customers get it done.

Explore customer stories.

AT&T unified its legacy systems with MuleSoft to give customers faster, more consistent service.

AT&T used MuleSoft Anypoint Platform to connect its siloed legacy systems, so reps in call centers and stores now see a customer’s full services in one interface. The company is now building a shared catalog of APIs and AI agents to scale future service and cut development costs.

Read AT&T’s story

Capita governs more than 350 AI agents with Agent Fabric.

Capita is becoming an AI-enabled outsourcing company, but its point-to-point integrations made it hard for agents to securely access data. It now uses Agent Fabric as a single governance layer for more than 350 production AI agents across Agentforce, Azure, and AWS. The result is 20% faster API development.

Read Capita's story

Salesforce Support cut case research from hours to under a minute with its Hive agent.

Salesforce’s MuleSoft support engineers had to check 12+ separate sources, such as GitHub, Slack, and Confluence, to answer one customer question. Using Agent Fabric, the team turned each source into an MCP server and built an agent broker (“Hive”) that routes questions and returns one answer. Wait time dropped from hours to under a minute, and engineers resolve about 30% more cases per day.

Read Salesforce’s story

RBC Wealth Management replaced weeks of paper-based onboarding with a fast digital process using MuleSoft.

RBC Wealth Management needed to unlock data trapped in legacy systems and replace paper-based onboarding that involved 200-300 page bundles. It built reusable APIs on MuleSoft Anypoint Platform to digitize onboarding and create a single customer view. Onboarding now averages 24 minutes, projects ship 3x faster, and maintenance costs are 50% lower.

Read RBC Wealth’s story

Smarsh automates millions in unbilled revenue with MuleSoft and strengthens its AI governance Agent Fabric.

After growing through acquisitions, Smarsh was left with fragmented systems and manual customer setup that took five-plus days. MuleSoft became its integration standard and Agent Fabric helps it track and govern AI usage. Automated usage tracking uncovered $2.2M in unbilled recurring revenue, and onboarding dropped to three seconds.

Read Smarsh’s story

Rush turned hours of manual API coding into minutes using MuleSoft Vibes.

Rush’s integration team spent substantial time hand-building DataWeave transformations and API frameworks for healthcare systems like its EHR. By adopting MuleSoft Vibes, an AI coding agent, from the start of each project, they cut a half-day API structuring task to 10 minutes. It also standardized their code and helped fix a complex production issue in under a day.

Read Rush University System for Health’s story

Saint-Gobain connected its factories and ERP systems to prove environmental compliance using MuleSoft.

Saint-Gobain’s siloed systems and an SAP S/4HANA migration made it hard to prove environmental compliance and present one face to global customers. MuleSoft Anypoint Platform now connects its cloud, supply chain, and factory-floor systems. The company deployed 90 workflows in six months, and API reuse rose from 35% to 57%.

Read Saint-Gobain’s story

One control plane. Five outcomes.

Agent Governance

Govern any agent

Every agent, MCP, and LLM call, governed by universal policies. Give teams consistent guardrails, trusted identity, and kill-switch controls across platforms.

Explore AI Gateway
Catch agent failures early

Catch agent failures early

Evaluate every agent from one place, no matter where they’re built. Automatically intervene when quality drops. MCP server and LLM evals coming soon.

Explore Agent Evals
Agent Registry

Find every agent 

Every agent, MCP, and API, automatically discovered across your AI landscape and unified in one continuously updated registry.

Explore Agent Registry
Agent Connectivity 

Give agents real work

Every business application, agent-ready in minutes. Turn APIs into MCP tools and orchestrate agents with hundreds of enterprise connectors.

Explore Agent Connectivity
AI Cost Management

Control AI costs

Every request, routed to the smallest model that can do the job. Prepaid budgets that can't be overrun, and a unified dashboard showing spend across every provider: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, and more.

Explore Cost Management
Get hands-on with Agent Fabric

See Agent Fabric for yourself in our free interactive demo. Experience the power of one single place to manage every agent across your business.

Take the tour

At Newell Brands, we’re building an agentic enterprise that scales. Agent Fabric acts as our secure AI control plane, governing agent access, allowing us to deploy intelligent, customer-centric agents that transform our service delivery across every brand.

Steve Sigrist
Vice President, Global Customer Service, Newell Brands

Agents stop where your systems stop

MuleSoft is the foundation under Agent Fabric. Without access to your apps, APIs, and data, agents can’t finish the job. MuleSoft connects and manages them all reliably, at scale.

Integration

Connect any system, app, or LLM with hundreds of pre-built connectors, and build faster with MuleSoft Dev Agent.

Explore integration

API Management

Design, secure, and govern every API and the agents that call them, from one control plane.

Explore API management

Deployment & Monitoring

Run in our cloud, yours, or both with real-time visibility before issues become outages.

Explore deployment & monitoring

Learn what’s actually happening with agentic AI.

AI is spreading faster than anyone can operationalize it, and the leaders we surveyed know it. Here are the trends and priorities that 11,000+ IT leaders are acting on.

Read the research

Get to ROI faster with expert help

Professional Services

Get tailored guidance from our team based on learnings from our customers.

Learn more

Partners

Find an expert to provide strategic guidance and technical expertise to extend the value of your investment.

Learn more

Training

Build expertise in your organization with courses and certifications curated for your role and skill set.

Learn more

Frequently Asked Questions

Agent Fabric is an AI control plane. It finds every agent, MCP server and API your business runs — across AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Copilot and more — then governs what they can do, connects them to your systems, and tracks what they cost.

It is deliberately vendor agnostic. Agent Fabric enables you to apply control to every agent, whoever built it and wherever it runs, without requiring it to be rebuilt, migrated or instrumented.

Agent Fabric has many capabilities, and they summarize into four main outcomes.

Find every agent. Agent Registry is a cross-platform catalog of every agent, MCP server and API in your enterprise. Scanners connect to each platform’s native APIs — AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Azure AI Foundry, Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Copilot and more — pull agent metadata such as model, tools, ownership, version and deployment status, and normalize it into one searchable registry.

Govern any agent. Agent Fabric’s unified AI Gateway is a single control point for every LLM, MCP and agent call. Universal guardrails and policies cover rate limiting, authentication, PII detection and masking, and data access controls — enforced on any agent regardless of the platform it was built on. An agent kill switch stops a rogue agent at the network, credential and identity layer. Trusted agent identity carries user context through the whole call chain, so an agent calling another agent, an MCP server or an API still acts as a specific user.

Connect AI anywhere. MCP support turns existing APIs into agent-ready tools. AI Connectors reach the systems agents need, including SAP, Workday, mainframe and partner data, and A2A support standardizes agent-to-agent communication. Multi-agent orchestration routes work to the best-fit agent, with as much determinism as the process requires.

Control AI costs. Semantic model routing matches every request to the most cost-effective model that can handle it. Prepaid token budgets cap spend by team, app or agent. A unified FinOps dashboard ranks spend across every provider and model, attributed to specific agents, teams and business units.

Scanners connect to each platform directly and pull the metadata — capabilities, model, tools, ownership, version, deployment status — then normalize it into one searchable registry. They run on a schedule, so new and updated agents keep surfacing rather than waiting to be filed. You can review what is discovered before it is promoted into the governed registry.

Agents can also be registered manually, so anything a scanner does not yet reach — a platform not covered, or an agent built in-house — still sits in the same registry under the same AI agent governance.

Policy is applied at the communication layer, so a third-party agent is governed without being modified or instrumented. That is what makes Agent Fabric vendor agnostic: the same agentic governance envelope applies whether an agent was built in Salesforce, on a hyperscaler, or inside software you bought.

Identity travels with the call too. When one agent calls another agent, an MCP server or a plain API, it still acts as a specific user — using your existing OAuth setup and identity provider.

Three ways, in the order most enterprises need them.

Visibility. One view of spend and budgets across every model, platform and department. A unified FinOps dashboard ranks spend across every AI asset so the biggest leaks show first, and budget management tracks allocation by organization, department or group in real time. You cannot govern what you cannot see.

Efficiency. Semantic routing matches each request to the most cost-effective model able to handle it, rather than sending everything to a premium model. Semantic caching recognizes when the same question is asked in different words and avoids the round trip. Cost optimization trims bloated context, tool descriptions and responses across your agents and MCPs.

Enforcement. Model Wallet locks in prepaid budgets by team, app or agent, so overspend stops before it starts rather than being flagged afterwards. An agent kill switch severs a rogue agent instantly at the network, credential and identity layer.

Yes. Agent Fabric is generally available today, with new and enhanced capabilities rolling out each month.

Point Agent Fabric at the platforms your teams already use and it registers every agent, MCP server and API it finds, so you have a complete inventory in minutes. Add guardrails, connect the systems your agents need, and set budgets from there, at your own pace.

Take the interactive tour, or talk to your account team.

They do different jobs. Agentforce is for building end-to-end agents: build, run, test and optimize interoperable agents within Salesforce, with full lifecycle coverage, trusted context and controlled behavior.

Agent Fabric is for any agent. It is the vendor-agnostic control plane that manages every agent your business runs, including the ones built on a hyperscaler, embedded in third-party software, or written by your own engineers.

MuleSoft, part of Salesforce, helps organizations connect their applications, data, and systems so they can work together seamlessly. Instead of building custom, one-off connections between every system, which are costly to maintain and hard to scale, MuleSoft lets you build reusable APIs that securely link everything from legacy databases to modern SaaS applications.

Its core platform is built around API-led connectivity, an approach that structures APIs in reusable layers so your integrations get faster and easier to maintain over time, not more complex.

Beyond building integrations, MuleSoft provides full API management capabilities to support APIs across their entire lifecycle, from design and security to monitoring and discovery, making it easy for teams to build, protect, and reuse APIs at scale.

As businesses increasingly adopt AI agents, MuleSoft's Agent Fabric extends this same foundation to help enterprises find, connect, govern, and optimize AI agents, giving them secure, managed access to the systems and data they need to take action, while keeping IT and security teams in control.

In short, MuleSoft makes it easier for your systems, data, and now AI agents, to work together securely, at scale, and without reinventing the wheel for every new connection.
